URL: https://www.itv.com/news/2026-05-17/keir-starmer-deciding-whether-to-announce-a-departure-timetable
TITLE: Starmer 'deciding whether to announce departure timetable'
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-17 13:42
AUTHOR: Robert Peston
SOURCE: ITV News

KEY POINTS:
- Starmer at Chequers retreat this weekend making "very difficult decision"
- Choice: reassert authority/re-energise government vs. announce timetable for leadership election and his own departure
- Knows that if Burnham wins Makerfield, he will be evicted regardless
- Either course will lose momentum until Burnham outcome known
- Some cabinet ministers believe "the die is already cast that he will have to resign in coming months, whether Burnham is elected an MP or not"
- Their view: PM should "acknowledge that reality" and use time-limited period to shape positive legacy
- Trade union leaders share this view
- Other ministers want him to stay — fear "mayhem if Burnham were to lose"
- Many opposed to him quitting will lose their jobs if Starmer replaced
- One minister: choice "is not so binary" — other options could keep "government show on the road"
- One minister: whatever Starmer decides, he will have to "spell this out explicitly and in detail to all of us"
- "Big personal judgment": whether Starmer becomes more or less of a lame duck by taking control of timing
- Colleagues "don't know what he will decide"
